quote.text: إذا حاولت أن تضطلع بِدَورٍ يتجاوز قدراتك. فأنت لا تخزي نفسك فيه فحسب، بل تصرفها أيضًا عما كانت قادرةً على أدائه.
quote.author: Epictetus
quote.aiInsight:
• Parenthood
    • Recognize that as a parent, attempting roles beyond your natural capacity can compromise both your well-being and the nurturing environment needed for your child’s growth.
    • By accepting your limits and focusing on what you do best—providing love, guidance, and stability—you create a model of authenticity and balance for your children.
  • Leadership
    • A truly effective leader is mindful of personal limits, understanding that overreaching can tarnish both individual credibility and team performance.
    • By delegating wisely and aligning tasks with inherent strengths, a leader cultivates an environment of trust, resilience, and genuine achievement.
  • Product Management
    • Attempting to manage a product scope that exceeds your resources or expertise often leads not only to missed opportunities but also to a devaluation of your team's potential.
    • Embracing clear, realistic objectives and leveraging your strengths ensures that the product vision is executed with excellence and integrity.
